scope: One provider-budget forward after the exact thumbnail ledger 90. Preserve old limits, owners, table ACL/RLS and G014 bodies; add the fixed Directions policy and private core. No worker, provider, credential or HTTP action.

executionContract.order: One caller-owned transaction: serializerSql first, atomicMigrationSql second. Never acquire the serializer in a second session or after the ledger lock. No internal BEGIN/COMMIT.
executionContract.ledger: Exclusive lock, exact prior 90-row digest and thumbnail terminal; original full vector inserted as 20261024130000/provider_budget_install; exact terminal 91 and unchanged 90-row prefix before commit.
executionContract.parser: Copy exact candidate bytes to an exclusive private temporary file named 20261024130000_provider_budget_install.sql; readOriginalStatementVector requires a 14-digit filename. Validate size/hash, use the unchanged official parser, and retain the original vector. Candidate is not an applied migration.
executionContract.ownerLease: Existing supabase_admin ADMIN-only row is preserved. Create a temporary owner bridge using a self-granted SET-only row, revoke own grant, run full G014 pre; grant only around the exact component, revoke, verify all memberships/roles/default ACL and unchanged function/table/policy metadata, then full G014 post and remove temporary objects.
executionContract.thumbnailReadback: Reuse the frozen terminal query over a CTE excluding only the new budget version; separately require exact real ledger count, target presence and unchanged full 90-row prefix digest. Do not change the frozen thumbnail manifest.
executionContract.writerCustody: Authenticated owner controls concurrent privileged catalog/ledger writers until the original attempt is reconciled. Normal business DML may continue; table lock waits can reject or delay requests. No new approval inferred.
executionContract.acknowledgementLoss: An absent target plus exact prior is only prior_observed, never proof the original backend ended. Preserve durable original admission/attempt/journal; no automatic resend. Reconcile exact target vector plus exact terminal as committed; extra rows or prefix drift are conflict.
